description: Inserts an existing calendar into the user's calendar list, with optional display settings. The primary keyword is not accepted; provide the actual calendar ID.

backgroundColor.description: The background color of the calendar in the Web UI. (Hexadecimal color code)
backgroundColor.human_parameter_description: Choose the background color you want for this calendar. Use a hex code like #000000.
backgroundColor.title: Background Color

colorId.description: The color of the calendar. This is an ID referring to an entry in the calendarCore color palette.
colorId.human_parameter_description: Pick a preset color by its ID from Google’s built-in palette. Use this if you prefer a preset color instead of custom hex codes.
colorId.title: Color Id

color_rgb_format.description: Whether to use the foregroundColor and backgroundColor fields to write the calendar colors (RGB). If this feature is used, the index-based colorId field will be set to the best matching option automatically. Optional. The default is False.
color_rgb_format.human_parameter_description: Turn this on if you’re setting custom colors using hex codes for background and text. Most people can leave it off unless they’re manually choosing both colors.
color_rgb_format.title: Color Rgb Format

defaultReminders.description: The default reminders that the authenticated user has for this calendar.
defaultReminders.human_parameter_description: Set automatic reminders that will apply to new events on this calendar. Add one or more reminders to get timely alerts.

method.description: The method used by this reminder (e.g., 'email', 'popup').
method.title: Method

minutes.description: Number of minutes before the start of the event when the reminder should trigger.
minutes.title: Minutes

defaultReminders.title: Default Reminders

foregroundColor.description: The foreground color of the calendar in the Web UI. (Hexadecimal color code)
foregroundColor.human_parameter_description: Choose the text/icon color so it’s readable against the background. Use a hex code like #FFFFFF.
foregroundColor.title: Foreground Color

hidden.description: Whether the calendar has been hidden from the list. Accepts only boolean values: true or false. If not specified, the API defaults to false.
hidden.human_parameter_description: Hide this calendar from your list without removing it. Turn on to keep it out of view.
hidden.title: Hidden

id.description: The identifier of the calendar to insert. Must be a valid calendar ID in email format (e.g., ‘user@example.com’ for a user’s calendar or ‘calendarid@group.calendar.google.com’ for a shared calendar). Note: The ‘primary’ keyword is not supported for this operation - use the actual email address of the primary calendar instead. The calendar must exist and you must have appropriate access permissions.
id.human_parameter_description: The email address or unique ID of the calendar you want to add to your list. You can copy this from the calendar’s settings or sharing details. Important: Don’t use ‘primary’ here - use the actual email address instead.
id.title: Id

notificationSettings.description: The notifications that the authenticated user is receiving for this calendar.
notificationSettings.human_parameter_description: Choose how and when you want to be notified about changes or events on this calendar.

method.description: The method used by this notification (e.g., 'email').
method.title: Method

notificationSettings.title: NotificationSetting

selected.description: Whether the calendar is selected and visible in the calendar list. Accepts only boolean values: true or false. If not specified, the API defaults to false.
selected.human_parameter_description: Show this calendar by default in your calendar view. Turn it off to leave the calendar unchecked by default.
selected.title: Selected

summaryOverride.description: The summary that the authenticated user has set for this calendar.
summaryOverride.human_parameter_description: Give this calendar a custom name as it appears in your list. Helpful for labeling shared or similar calendars.
summaryOverride.title: Summary Override

name: calendar_list_insert

accessRole.description: The effective access role that the authenticated user has on the calendar.
accessRole.title: Access Role

backgroundColor.description: The background color of the calendar in RGB hex (e.g., '#2952A3', '#b3dc6c'). To set this property via updates, the colorRgbFormat parameter must be true.
backgroundColor.title: Background Color

colorId.description: The color of the calendar. This is an ID referring to a color in the CalendarListEntry colors collection. Mutually exclusive with backgroundColor/foregroundColor in colorRgbFormat updates.
colorId.title: Color Id

defaultReminders.description: The default reminders that the authenticated user has for this calendar. When the user has no default reminders, this is an empty list.
defaultReminders.title: Default Reminders

deleted.description: Whether this calendar list entry has been deleted from the calendar list. Read-only.
deleted.title: Deleted

description.description: Description of the calendar. Read-only; mirrors the calendar's description.
description.title: Description

display_url.description: URL to view this calendar in Google Calendar web UI. Points to the calendar settings page.
display_url.title: Display Url

etag.description: ETag of the resource. Used for versioning and concurrency control.
etag.title: Etag

foregroundColor.description: The foreground (text) color of the calendar in RGB hex (e.g., '#FFFFFF', '#000000'). To set this property via updates, the colorRgbFormat parameter must be true.
foregroundColor.title: Foreground Color

hidden.description: Deprecated. Whether the calendar has been hidden from the list.
hidden.title: Hidden

kind.description: Type of the resource. Always 'calendar#calendarListEntry' for calendar list entries.
kind.title: Kind

location.description: Geographic location of the calendar as free-form text. Read-only; mirrors the calendar's location.
location.title: Location

notificationSettings.description: The notifications that the authenticated user is receiving for this calendar.
notificationSettings.title: Notification Settings

primary.description: Whether the calendar is the primary calendar of the authenticated user. Read-only.
primary.title: Primary

selected.description: Deprecated. Whether the calendar content shows up in the calendar UI.
selected.title: Selected

summary.description: Title of the calendar. Read-only; mirrors the calendar's summary unless a user-defined summaryOverride is set.
summary.title: Summary

summaryOverride.description: User-provided name for the calendar displayed in the user's calendar list. If set, it overrides the calendar's default summary.
summaryOverride.title: Summary Override

timeZone.description: The time zone of the calendar in IANA format (e.g., 'America/Los_Angeles', 'UTC'). Read-only; mirrors the calendar's timeZone.
timeZone.title: Time Zone

method.description: The method used to deliver the notification.
method.title: Method

allowedConferenceSolutionTypes.description: The types of conference solutions that are allowed for this calendar.
allowedConferenceSolutionTypes.title: Allowed Conference Solution Types

method.description: The method used by this reminder.
method.title: Method

minutes.description: Number of minutes before the start of the event when the reminder should trigger.
minutes.title: Minutes

notifications.description: The list of notifications set for this calendar.
notifications.title: Notifications
